Privacy Policy

Last Updated: February 2026

1. Zero Data Collection Policy

FastUUIDGenerator operates under a strict Zero-Collection Policy. All UUID, GUID, validation, and decoding operations are executed exclusively within your client web browser using the standard Web Cryptography API.

2. No Server-Side Logging or Telemetry

We do not transmit, log, intercept, or store any generated keys, decoded timestamp values, or validation payloads on any backend server or third-party database.

3. Local Storage

We use your browser's local storage (localStorage) strictly to preserve your selected theme preference (Light / Dark mode). No tracking identifiers, cookies, or profiling data are stored.

4. Third-Party Services

This website is hosted on high-performance static content delivery networks (CDNs). Standard ephemeral HTTP request access logs (such as IP addresses and User-Agent headers) may be recorded by the edge CDN strictly for DDoS mitigation and network security purposes in compliance with industry standards.

5. Changes to This Policy

Any future modifications to this policy will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
